as_told.title: Peter Thiel on Rogan: faster-than-light aliens must be angels or demons

plain: The tech investor Peter Thiel is said to have argued, on Joe Rogan's popular interview podcast in 2024, that if aliens are real they must be something like angels or demons. Michels says Thiel was on the show "a month ago", that half the talk was about aliens, and that he cited the work of the religious studies scholar Diana Pasulka; in another episode Thiel's reasoning is paraphrased as: "If you have faster than light travel, there's something really crazy that has to be true on a cultural, political, social level."
